subject: Quarterly health & capacity runway — proposal for stretch capacity and SLA options
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Ranjit Patel <ranjit.patel@greenmosaic.ai>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quarterly health & capacity runway — proposal for stretch capacity and SLA options

Hi Ranjit,

Thanks again for the time yesterday. I pulled together a short health recap for GreenMosaic's Q1–Q2 runway and a couple of options for a short-term stretch and an SLA-backed lane you asked about. Key highlights: 

- Q1 token spend: 18.6M; average latency p95 (prod): 220ms on the r-inference-3 cluster.
- Peak hourly token rate: ~1.1M tokens/hr (observed on 2027-04-14 during campaign launch).
- Current reserved capacity covers ~75% of expected sustained traffic; prefix caching reduced token cost ~12% in the month of April.

Attached: greenmosaic_q1_usage_report.pdf (breakdown by route/model), and a draft pricing sheet for stretch/SLA: proposed_sla_pricing.xlsx.

Two proposals we recommend:
1) Short-term capacity burst pool — 200% burst credits for 90 days (no model changes). Good when you expect spikes.
2) SLA-backed Dedicated lane — guaranteed 99.9% token throughput with prioritized preemption and a 25% discount on net unit price for a 12‑month commit. Includes fine-grained tracing and per-route latency dashboards.

If you want, we can run a lightweight simulation of your peak week on the SLA lane to estimate token economics and end-to-end latency improvements — that usually makes the tradeoffs concrete for execs.

Are you open for a 30-min call on Monday to go through the numbers and align on the preferred path? I included Laura (CSD) and Ben (Sales Ops) to help scope any contract/ops changes quickly.

Thanks,
Karthik

--
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Enterprise
Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0132

Attachments: greenmosaic_q1_usage_report.pdf (pdf, 420KB); proposed_sla_pricing.xlsx (xlsx, 38KB)

From: Ranjit Patel <ranjit.patel@greenmosaic.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: GreenMosaic Legal <legal@greenmosaic.ai>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 10:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quarterly health & capacity runway — proposal for stretch capacity and SLA options

Karthik,

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the report — that level of granularity is helpful. A few quick clarifying questions before we book time with our finance and legal teams: 

- Can you break down the 18.6M tokens by route (Chat vs. Embed vs. Rerank)? Our bill needs to map to feature cost centers.
- For the SLA lane, what are the specific remedies for sustained latency degradation vs. occasional spikes?
- Any impact on our data retention / audit logs if we move to Dedicated SLA? We have a quarterly compliance review next month.

We are generally inclined toward a short-term burst to cover an expected marketing spike in June, but finance wants the 12-month economics laid out before they greenlight an SLA locked commit. If possible, please include an expected per-token unit price range (after discount) for both the burst and the SLA options.

I can do Monday 11:00–11:30 PT for a quick call.

Thanks,
Ranjit

--
Ranjit Patel
Head of AI Platform
GreenMosaic
ranjit.patel@greenmosaic.ai
+1 (617) 555-0199

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Ranjit Patel <ranjit.patel@greenmosaic.ai>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai, tessa.morgan@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quarterly health & capacity runway — proposal for stretch capacity and SLA options

Ranjit — thanks, good questions. Laura / Ben / Tessa, looping you in so we can put together the expanded breakdown and legal/ops notes. Quick notes below while we assemble the detailed attachments: 

- Route split (quick preview): Chat ~58% tokens, Embeddings ~30%, Rerank ~12% (we'll attach the per-route CSV).
- Remedies for SLA lane: financial credits tied to sustained p95 latency above target for a 30‑minute window (detailed tiers in the SLA doc); operational remedies include prioritized scheduling and guaranteed KV-cache warmups for pinned models. I'll ask Legal to surface the exact credit calculations.
- Data retention: Dedicated SLA includes an option to retain request/response logs for up to 12 months with a customer-managed KMS; default retention aligns with your current config, but we can add longer retention as an add-on (there's a separate pricing line).

Ben — can you produce a per-token price band for the two options: 
- Burst pool (90d): estimated unit price range after credits: $0.0024–$0.0030/token (depending on actual mix)
- 12-month SLA lane (committed): estimated $0.0019–$0.0023/token after 25% commit discount and caching improvements.

Laura / Tessa — Ranjit flagged a compliance review — can we confirm what artifacts they need for SOC-type audits (audit logs, KMS attestation, retention controls) and whether we can turn those on prior to contract signature in pilot mode?

I'll prep an abbreviated pricing appendix and a simulation run for their highest traffic week (we can show delta cost and latency). Ranjit — Monday 11:00 PT works. I'll send a calendar invite.

-Karthik

--
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Enterprise
Redwood Inference

From: laura.bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai, tessa.morgan@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 08:13:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quarterly health & capacity runway — proposal for stretch capacity and SLA options

Team — quick deliverables before Monday's customer call: 

1) Ben: finalize per-token price bands and attach a short one-pager explaining assumptions (routing mix, effective caching uplift).
2) Tessa: confirm we can enable trial-level extended retention + KMS demo for GreenMosaic and list any additional security questionnaire items they commonly ask for.
3) Karthik: run the peak-week simulation and include expected p95 latency improvements for the SLA lane vs hosted. Include assumptions about model variants/quantization.

I will draft a short email to GreenMosaic legal that summarizes remedies and a high-level timetable for contract changes (15 business days typical for addendum). Use the shared Drive doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/GM-3217/runway-report for tracking.

Laura

--
